name: Obama (Nagasaki, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Obama town emblem in green: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised mountain above waves.
history: Flag of the former town of Obama in Nagasaki Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-10-11. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1970.

features.role: Obama town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised mountain above waves
